interface.longDescription: Abhar Mastery promt extrem combines advanced prompt engineering with evidence-led research, source appraisal, rigorous fact-checking, critical audits, red-team analysis, technical verification, standards-compliance reviews, and conditional MarkItDown-first file ingestion. For content-focused file reading it prefers Markdown extraction when a real MarkItDown converter is connected; when users explicitly require preserving visual style or layout, it prioritizes the original visual file. It never claims conversion or verification that did not occur.
